_what: How tool:hold-to-it (read-data/hold-to-it.mjs) works out a group's agreements. `types` are the record types of the agreement and mark the answer is shaped for (ids start with them). The policy is handed in with the request: `marks` [{ id, label, points, when: present | absent | not_arranged | unclear | not_done, miss? }], `defaults` { minutes, time_zone, remind_minutes, check_after_minutes }, and optionally `evidence_before_minutes`, `evidence_after_minutes` and `unnamed_prefixes`, how a voice with no name is labelled. `default_area` is what an unnamed merit area of a mark is called in a person's totals. `words` are what the answers say.

words.no_policy: Give the group's policy in the request (policy). This tool has no default marks and no default times.
words.bad_policy: The policy needs marks (a list), and defaults with a time zone and a meeting length in minutes.
words.needs_who: Say who agreed (agreed_by, a list of names).
words.needs_agreement: Say which agreement (agreement: the held agreement, with its agreement_id).
words.needs_arranged: Say whether the meeting was set up on the calendar (arranged: true or false), read from the calendar.
words.no_agreement: Agreement {agreement_id} does not belong to this group.
words.bad_zone: {zone} is not a time zone name such as Europe/London.
words.kept: Kept: {what}. {who} agreed. It is set for its time, with a reminder {remind} minutes before and a check afterwards of who came.
words.choose_time: {who} agreed to {what}, but nobody said when. Choose a time.
words.choose_time_suggested: {who} agreed to {what}, but nobody said when. Suggested: {suggested}. Say yes or choose another time.
words.kept_no_time: Kept: {what}. {who} agreed. Nobody said when, so nothing is set; the group is asked to choose a time.
words.no_time: This agreement has no time yet.
words.remind: {what} is in {minutes} minutes. {who} agreed to it.
words.not_arranged: {what}: nobody set it up for {who}. Next: {next}.
words.unclear: {what}: {count} voices heard had no names, so {who} could not be counted. Next: {next}.
